faqs.a:
A disabled member who has been, or shall be, returned to active service in the employ
               of the city as a police officer as provided in this chapter, shall be given service
               credit for the period the member was receiving disability pay from funds of the retirement
               system on account of the member's city employment.
(Code 1960, § 19-13(C); Code 1981, § 26-60)
